title: Where Is the Unseen Razor?
description: Lan seems to have changed her mind about seeking the Unseen Razor.

mainQuestExcel.title: Where Is the Unseen Razor?
mainQuestExcel.description: Lan seems to have changed her mind about seeking the Unseen Razor.

dialogs.text: Hmph, looks like it should be here.
Lan?
Traveler. I didn't expect to see you here.
Do you remember the sword hilt you found last time? Well, it turns out that it was indeed part of the Unseen Razor.
The funny thing is, the only reason I could recognize it is because I secretly etched a marking onto it as a child...
I remember I told my brother that if he ever decided to wield another sword, he had to give the Unseen Razor to me.
Heh. I suppose neither one of us could have foreseen how things turned out... I can't believe this is how I ended up finding the Unseen Razor. Looks like the sword... really did get shattered.
Alright. I suppose I'll cut to the chase now that you're here, Traveler. I'm going to need your help again.
Two gatherings of monsters should be loitering somewhere ahead. They seem to have amassed a sizable inventory of damaged weapons to hoard within their camps, though I'm uncertain as to why.

The Adventurers' Guild is worried that these monsters will wreak havoc on the surroundings and originally wanted to draft a commission to resolve this. However, after I reviewed the details, I thought that perhaps... I could find some pieces of the Unseen Razor here.
Traveler, let's each clear out a camp.
The camp to the left is being held by a group of hilichurls. Alone, each of them should present no danger to you...
But their numbers are substantial. Should you face them directly and all at once, it might require some effort to prevail, even for you.
On the right is a Stonehide Lawachurl. As for how dangerous facing one is... I don't think I really need to elaborate.
Since I'm the one who asked for your aid, I'll let you select which camp to clear.
What are you doing here?
I'll take the left side.
Understood. I'll go for the other one. Let's make this quick.
I'll take care of the camp on the right.
Understood. I'll go for the other one. Let's make this quick.
How goes it? You've cleared the monsters on your end?
You've already... defeated all the monsters in the area?
Hmm? Of course.
I mean, I am the president of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild. Dealing with monsters is pretty typical for me.
Hmph, looks like it should be here.
Lan?
Traveler? Fancy running into you here again.
Yeah, I managed to get a few new fragments through some more... appropriate commissions.
The situation is the same as it was previously. I'd like to invite you to head out with me and defeat some monsters.
The camp to the left is being held by a group of hilichurls. Alone, each of them should present no danger to you...
But their numbers are substantial. Should you face them directly and all at once, it might require some effort to prevail, even for you.
On the right is a Stonehide Lawachurl. As for how dangerous facing one is... I don't think I really need to elaborate.
Since I'm the one who asked for your aid, I'll let you select which camp to clear.
Are you still looking for sword fragments?
How goes it? You've cleared the monsters on your end?
You've already... defeated all the monsters in the area?
Hmm? Of course.
I mean, I am the president of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild. Dealing with monsters is pretty typical for me.
How goes it? You've cleared the monsters on your end?
You've already... defeated all the monsters in the area?
Hmm? Of course.
I mean, I am the president of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild. Dealing with monsters is pretty typical for me.
Traveler, have you already wiped out the monsters in that camp?
All done.
Just some ordinary monsters. It didn't take too much out of me. I also got lucky and found a valuable piece from a longsword.
I haven't found anything on my side...
Don't worry about it. You helped me rule out a misidentified location, so thanks.
Here, you've earned this.
If we find all the shards...
My desire is a simple one... I just want to reforge the Unseen Razor.
Though the blueprints detailing how the Unseen Razor was made and what materials were used have been lost... I'll find a way.
If I can reforge the Unseen Razor, then my brother will also... *sigh*
What will you do with them?
How's it going on your end?
Traveler, have you already wiped out the monsters in that camp?
All done.
Just some ordinary monsters. It didn't take too much out of me. Shame that I didn't find anything of value. It's just scrap here.
How'd it go on your end? Did you find anything?
I found this.
Huh... That looks like a piece of a sword... Thanks. I'll bring it back with me and examine it more closely.
Thanks, Traveler. Here's your payment. Please accept it.
